selection_disclosure: Five task IDs with known prior favorable both-proved L code-size and time outcomes are deliberately retained. Ten new tasks were source-screened on private candidates; eight are closely related results from one log-sum-exp/softmax paper and two are from a general summation-tree paper. This is clustered, exploratory development evidence, not an independent held-out effect estimate. The corpus is not admitted until every private audit and collision gate passes; no measured result may be dropped or silently rerun after launch.
